item.question: What evidence package is required to determine whether intranasal SGL-001 can achieve reproducible CNS exposure beyond rodent models?
item.rationale: Failure to achieve adequate CNS exposure in larger species could invalidate the intended route and stop the program.

selection_reason: Selected open_translational_risk at critical priority. Ranking favors program-threatening translational risks, then blocking decisions, evidence contradictions, formulation and delivery questions, experiment design, evidence gaps, and lower-priority refinement.
